scope: Correct EV-B01 path-role binding only. No implementation, imports, tests, state calls, platform calls, privilege changes or matrix cells.

inheritance.precedence: Only path inventory, PathRole interpretation and corresponding contract references are extended. All other S2-EU rules remain unchanged.
inheritance.profile_refs: Future F.isolation_contract and F.recorder_format_contract are exact FileRefs to this addendum, which pins the complete S2-EU contract.
inheritance.case_refs: CaseSpecification.expected_observation_contract and TraceHeader.expected_contract_digest remain bound to S2-EU. Header.profile_digest binds the F referencing this addendum.
inheritance.no_cycle: Sources/contracts -> F -> RunBinding -> external authorization/review -> traces/B -> Q. Authorization/review path names are fixed before RunBinding; their later digests do not enter it.

inventory.key: Unique (case_id, role); case_id null for globals/source/directory, otherwise exact owning case.
inventory.completeness: Exactly all instantiated templates plus admitted source and derived directory rows. No extra rows. Declaration is not creation or durable reservation.
inventory.order: Null case first, then p01-p13; within each case, role by original unsigned UTF-16 code units.
inventory.path: Absolute CanonicalPath from prebound parents or admitted read inputs only. No cwd, escape, arbitrary temporary directory or fallback.
inventory.uniqueness: No duplicate key or canonical path; no input/output or file/directory overlap. Access aliases create no rows. Native alias/identity checks still apply.

source_derivation.index: Zero-based decimal without leading zeros, exactly 0..n-1.
source_derivation.input_set: Exactly the preregistered intentional read closure from admitted publisher/recorder SourceRefs and required contract/prerequisite/authorization/review FileRefs. Already admitted runtime source checks may contribute only their explicit paths.
source_derivation.ordering: Deduplicate exact canonical paths, then sort by original unsigned UTF-16 code units. No locale or case normalization.
source_derivation.provenance: The independent preregistration review checks every row against its originating reference and the exact required read closure; arbitrary extra source rows reject.
source_derivation.authorization: Authorization/review path names precede RunBinding; their FileRef digests follow it. Do not insert those later hashes into RunBinding.
source_derivation.boundary: No widened read permission or backend domain. In particular, source roles do not bypass WindowsFiles.read_source root checks. Incompatible or missing binding blocks.

directory_derivation.index: Zero-based decimal without leading zeros, exactly 0..m-1.
directory_derivation.input_set: Union of all four ParentSet paths and all their ancestors to the drive root, plus parents and ancestors of all intentionally opened admitted source files.
directory_derivation.ordering: Deduplicate exact canonical paths, then sort by original unsigned UTF-16 code units. No extra directory.
directory_derivation.identity: ParentSet endpoints retain expected identities. Other directories obtain identity from their first validated native handle and are held/rechecked using unchanged backend rules. Lexical derivation invents no identity.
directory_derivation.drive_query: GetDriveTypeW maps its derived drive-root path to that directory row, never to a volume handle.

call_binding.resolve: Full native pathname resolves to exactly one inventory row; handle calls inherit the actor's current logical-handle binding. Owner case comes from the row, not necessarily TraceEntry.case_id.
call_binding.create: CreateFileW BEGIN/RETURN retain the resolved role; bind a new logical handle only after success.
call_binding.rename: BEGIN/RETURN retain staging role. Native target must equal the unique same-parent edge destination. Only after native success does the same handle acquire the destination role, with unchanged FileIdentity. Failure leaves the mapping unchanged.
call_binding.parents: parent.repository, parent.git_common, parent.ledger and parent.output are endpoint aliases to canonical directory rows, not additional rows. Native helper calls use canonical directory/source roles.
call_binding.p06_alias: foreign_write_handle is only the existing p06 E1 helper CreateFileW trigger alias to (p06, case_reservation). No new file or successful-write permission.
call_binding.p13: Only p13 reads p01 subject artifacts without live confirmations. Trace case stays p13; path/handle resolution supplies p01 ownership.
call_binding.control: Recorder/supervisor calls stay in the separate control transcript. No invented case IDs or changed native-failure case counts.
call_binding.reject: Unknown/multiple role resolution, wrong actor or phase, wrong rename destination or unbound input rejects before the dependent operation, preserving existing error/status precedence.
call_binding.trace_format: No new trace fields or native API parameters. Existing full paths, typed API arguments, actor IDs and logical handles carry the binding.

exceptions.binding: Only the one expected output identity changes, never path mapping or actual directory.
Helper sentinel uses the same case_reservation after E0; subject must reach the original CREATE_NEW rejection.
Helper sentinel uses the same target_reservation after E1; no substituted early rejection.
Helper sentinel uses the same final after E4 and the last absence check; no replacement of the actual rename rejection.
Only the bound foreign write-open attempt; it must reach native share rejection rather than a new policy rejection.
Injection reaches only bound subject roles, never recorder/control paths.
No subject writes; separate trace/spool/stage are recorder-owned writes.

global_lifecycle_rules: Every successful owned handle closes once. A new read-only verification handle is separately tracked and closes once; no retry after uncertain close.
Each scheduled write request fully transfers or stops; no short-write repair. Spool I/O is the separately audited recorder, not repeated WindowsFiles.write_complete on one handle.
Spools are nonfinal, frozen once, never renamed to final evidence and never rewritten after freeze.
Direct reservations and markers are not renamed spools. Only declared staging edges can rename, once, in the same parent, without replacement.
Role declaration, creation, rename and readability do not constitute completion. S2-EU live barriers, complete records and successful closes remain mandatory.
Control I/O does not recursively log itself; its own final flush/close and supervisor completion remain independently observed as already required by S2-EU.
No new control payload schema, witness protocol, native API, case, phase, retry or success criterion.

PLATFORM_RESERVATION.create: CREATE_NEW at the existing reservation step
PLATFORM_RESERVATION.use: Bound attempt reservation only; no rename/rewrite
PLATFORM_RESERVATION.flush: Full write, own file flush, byte/identity verification
PLATFORM_RESERVATION.close: Existing S2-EU reservation close ordering; once per handle

CASE_RESERVATION.create: E1 CREATE_NEW; exact p03 sentinel exception
CASE_RESERVATION.use: Bound case reservation only; no rollback/rename
CASE_RESERVATION.flush: Unchanged E1 own flush and verification; p03 native rejection unchanged
CASE_RESERVATION.close: Once per handle; unchanged case cleanup

TARGET_RESERVATION.create: E2 CREATE_NEW; exact p04 sentinel exception
TARGET_RESERVATION.use: Bound target reservation only; no rollback/rename
TARGET_RESERVATION.flush: Unchanged E2 own flush and verification; p04 native rejection unchanged
TARGET_RESERVATION.close: Once per handle; unchanged case cleanup

SUBJECT_STAGING.create: E4 fresh CREATE_NEW with rename permission
SUBJECT_STAGING.use: Fixed S2-EU bytes; only one E5 edge to same-case final
SUBJECT_STAGING.flush: E4 full write, own flush and verification
SUBJECT_STAGING.close: Same handle retained across successful rename; otherwise unchanged failed-case cleanup

SUBJECT_FINAL.create: Only rename destination except p05 sentinel
SUBJECT_FINAL.use: No payload rewrite; p13 read-only only for p01
SUBJECT_FINAL.flush: E6 same-file post-rename flush and full name/identity/byte checks
SUBJECT_FINAL.close: E8 once per handle; all original completion rules

FIXTURE_EVIDENCE.flush: Full write, own flush, full verification
FIXTURE_EVIDENCE.close: Once per handle before case completion

FIXTURE_SEAL.create: E4 CREATE_NEW after bound payload barrier
FIXTURE_SEAL.flush: Full write, own flush, full verification
FIXTURE_SEAL.close: Once per handle before case completion

FIXTURE_MARKER.flush: Full write, own marker flush, full verification; p10-p12 unchanged
FIXTURE_MARKER.close: Once per handle; no success after bound p12 failure

RECORDER_SPOOL.create: CREATE_NEW at first scheduled recorder use
RECORDER_SPOOL.use: Ordered original trace/transcript stream, then immutable freeze; never rename
RECORDER_SPOOL.flush: Each finite write request complete; at freeze own flush and full byte/identity checks
RECORDER_SPOOL.close: Once after freeze; later read-only verification uses a separately tracked handle

RECORDING_STAGE.create: Fresh CREATE_NEW with rename permission after original/serialized bytes are frozen
RECORDING_STAGE.use: Exact immutable trace/transcript or B/manifest bytes; one recording edge only
RECORDING_STAGE.flush: Full write, own flush and verification before rename
RECORDING_STAGE.close: Retain same handle into destination; unchanged abort cleanup on failure

RECORDING_FINAL.use: Immutable final evidence; no direct create/append/replacement
RECORDING_FINAL.close: Once per handle before live recorder completion

RECORDING_MARKER.flush: Full write, own marker flush, full verification
RECORDING_MARKER.close: Once before live completion; readable marker alone insufficient

CONTROL_SPOOL.create: CREATE_NEW at the existing control-recording step
CONTROL_SPOOL.use: Separate ordered control transcript, never final evidence; excludes recursive recording of own I/O
CONTROL_SPOOL.flush: Full writes; final own flush and verification after other data-path recording
CONTROL_SPOOL.close: Last own close after other recorded data handles; independent caller observes this boundary and supervisor exit; no extra witness file

EXISTING_SOURCE.owner: only actors already admitted to that source read
EXISTING_SOURCE.use: Exact independently bound source; no backend-domain widening
EXISTING_SOURCE.flush: No writes, flush, rename or deletion

EXISTING_DIRECTORY.owner: actors whose admitted backend call needs that directory
EXISTING_DIRECTORY.use: Inspect/pin/recheck under unchanged backend; no arbitrary child-file access
EXISTING_DIRECTORY.flush: No writes, directory flush, rename or deletion
